tactical_thesis: Use seven operators by retaining Melantha as the permanent lower-outer blocker and removing the Spot handoff. Split medicine by corridor and move the artillery caster to the upper eastern platform: Ansel covers Melantha and Friston; Hibiscus covers Midnight, Fang and Steward. Steward faces UP from [2,7], covering the eastern artillery transit and both eastern waiting points. After artillery clearance, rotate him into central coverage. This is an unsimulated, falsifiable full-stage hypothesis, not a demonstrated seven-operator WIN. The principal unresolved bottleneck is upper-central armor clearance before Fang's late runner queue exceeds two.
